grader.scenario: TV box error CS-201 on subscribed sports channels; entitlement refresh sent but propagation prevents live confirmation
grader.notes: Okay call featuring failed branding, dead air breaches, rude accusations, unverified resolution due to key propagation delay, and handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('S-Net TV digital services...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent allowed two separate unmanaged dead air gaps of 40 seconds at turns 14 and 34.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Philip throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense panic and fury this is causing with twenty guests arriving for the derby match in two hours, Philip...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased sports subscription error CS-201.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent dispatched entitlement re-hit, verified mobile streaming workaround, and provided goodwill credit.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you leave your TV set-top box powered down at the wall plug overnight to save electricity, the box misses the automated overnight security refresh cycles.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on error codes and reboot steps.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: TV box still displayed error CS-201 with customer advised to wait 1-2 hours for key ring propagation.
